description: This file contains a set of shell script functions and definitions that interface with the procd API for service management, including service lifecycle control, configuration, triggers, and inter-process communication via ubus. It is a helper script used within a larger init or service management system.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new procd service with a specified name and optional script.

methods.name: procd_close_service
methods.description: Finalizes the service description and sends a command to set the service configuration.

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Starts a new instance within a service with optional name.

methods.name: procd_close_instance
methods.description: Completes an instance configuration, including default respawn parameters if missing.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a specific service (and optional instance) is currently running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a service or a specific instance of a service.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to a service or its instance.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Returns the current status of a service/instance, including whether it is active or inactive.

methods.name: procd_add_mdns_service
methods.description: Adds a multicast DNS service registration.

methods.name: procd_add_mdns
methods.description: Adds mDNS registration data to the configuration.

methods.name: uci_load_validate
methods.description: Validates and optionally executes a callback for a UCI section.
